name: T-shirt
definition: Pullover top of jersey fabric with short or long sleeves and no collar or front opening.

name: Corset top
definition: Corset-shaped bustier or corset made to be worn visible as a top (a foundation corset is A1.5.1.03).

name: Button-up shirt
definition: Woven shirt with a collar and a full-length button front, in casual or smart-casual use.

name: Dress shirt
definition: Woven shirt made to be worn with a tie or under a suit, with a stiffer collar and button cuffs or cufflink cuffs.

name: Overshirt (shacket)
definition: Heavier shirt-construction garment worn as a light outer layer; a garment sold as a shacket with shirt construction.

name: Polo shirt
definition: Knit or piqué pullover shirt with a collar and a short button placket.

name: Kurta [kurti]
definition: Loose collarless or short-collared tunic shirt of South Asian dress, hip to knee length.

name: Pullover sweater
definition: Knitted top with no front opening, worn as a mid layer or outer layer.

name: Cardigan
definition: Knitted top with a front opening fastened by buttons, a zip or a tie, or left open.

name: Sweatshirt
definition: Pullover top of sweatshirt jersey with a ribbed neck, cuffs and hem and no hood.

name: Hoodie
definition: Sweatshirt-type top with an attached hood, with or without a front zip.

name: Fleece pullover
definition: Pullover of napped synthetic pile with no front opening; the material is the form.

name: Jeans
definition: Five-pocket trousers of denim or denim-like twill; fit, weight and selvedge are attributes.

name: Chinos
definition: Lightweight cotton twill trousers with a flat front and slanted pockets.

name: Cargo trousers
definition: Trousers with large patch pockets on the thighs or legs.

name: Work pants
definition: Hard-wearing trousers made for work in cotton twill, duck or similar fabric.

name: Joggers
definition: Casual trousers of jersey or fleece with an elasticated or ribbed waist and ankle cuffs.

name: Hakama
definition: Pleated, wide-legged or divided traditional Japanese trousers tied at the waist.

name: Chainsaw trousers
definition: Trousers with cut-resistant protective layers, worn for chainsaw work; hazard rating is an attribute.

name: Shorts
definition: Garment for the lower body with short legs ending at or above the knee.

name: Skirt
definition: Garment hanging from the waist or hips, open or closed below, without leg divisions; length and cut are attributes.

name: Dress
definition: One-piece garment covering the torso and extending below the waist, with or without sleeves; length and neckline are attributes.

name: Jumper dress (pinafore) [JSK]
definition: Sleeveless dress made to be worn over a blouse or top.

name: Dirndl
definition: Traditional Alpine dress of bodice, full skirt and apron.

name: Lehenga choli
definition: South Asian outfit of a long flared skirt (lehenga) and a fitted short blouse (choli), usually with a dupatta.

name: Ruqun
definition: Traditional Chinese two-piece dress of an upper garment and a wrapped skirt.

name: Overalls (dungarees)
definition: Trousers with a bib and shoulder straps, worn over or without a top.

name: Jumpsuit
definition: One-piece garment joining a top and trousers.

name: Boiler suit
definition: One-piece work garment with sleeves and legs, worn over other clothing.

name: Bee suit
definition: One-piece protective suit with a veil or hood, worn by beekeepers.

name: Costume
definition: Dress-up outfit sold as a set, with no single garment form.

name: Business suit
definition: Tailored set of a jacket with matching trousers or skirt, for business and formal day wear.

name: Tuxedo
definition: Formal evening suit with satin or grosgrain facings, worn with a bow tie.

name: Sari
definition: Long unstitched length of cloth draped round the body over a blouse and petticoat.

name: Kimono
definition: Traditional Japanese T-shaped wrapped robe; type (furisode, houmongi, komon, tomesode, iromuji) is a named form and formality an attribute.

name: Yukata
definition: Unlined cotton summer robe of Japanese dress.

name: Sarong (kanga)
definition: Length of cloth wrapped round the waist or body.

name: Dhoti
definition: Length of cloth wrapped and tied round the waist and legs by men in South Asian dress.

name: Dupatta
definition: Long scarf-like length of cloth worn over the shoulders or head with South Asian dress.

name: Shawl (stole)
definition: Rectangular or triangular length of cloth worn over the shoulders or arms.

name: Blazer (sport coat)
definition: Tailored jacket worn without matching trousers, including school and club blazers.

name: MA-1 flight jacket
definition: Short nylon bomber jacket with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, in the MA-1 pattern.

name: M-65 field jacket
definition: Cotton field jacket with four pockets and a concealed hood, in the M-65 pattern.

name: Harrington jacket
definition: Short lightweight zip jacket with a stand collar and a tartan lining.

name: Coach jacket
definition: Short unlined nylon jacket with a snap front and a collar.

name: Trucker jacket
definition: Short work jacket with a pointed collar, chest pockets and button front, in denim, corduroy or other fabric.

name: Chore coat
definition: Boxy workwear jacket with a button front and patch pockets.

name: Souvenir jacket [sukajan]
definition: Embroidered satin bomber-style jacket in the Japanese souvenir jacket tradition.

name: Varsity jacket
definition: Wool body and leather sleeves jacket with a ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, as worn by school and college teams.

name: Rider's jacket (biker jacket)
definition: Close-fitting short jacket of leather or other tough material cut for motorcycle riding, with an asymmetric zip front.

name: Mountain parka
definition: Hooded outdoor jacket of waterproof or windproof fabric, cut for hill and mountain use.

name: Shell jacket
definition: Waterproof or windproof jacket with no insulation, for rain and wind.

name: Fleece jacket
definition: Zip-front jacket of napped synthetic pile; the material is the form.

name: Puffer jacket
definition: Quilted insulated jacket, down or synthetic filled, ending at the hip or above; fill and fill power are attributes.

name: Chef's jacket
definition: Double-breasted, white or dark cotton jacket worn by cooks.

name: Haori
definition: Traditional Japanese hip-length jacket worn over a kimono.

name: Trench coat
definition: Belted, double-breasted raincoat with shoulder straps and a storm flap.

name: Pea coat
definition: Short, double-breasted wool coat with wide lapels and slash pockets.

name: Duffle coat
definition: Hooded wool coat fastened with toggles and loops.

name: Puffer coat
definition: Quilted insulated coat, down or synthetic filled, ending below the hip; fill and fill power are attributes.

name: Beizi
definition: Traditional Chinese long side-opening outer garment.

name: Puffer vest
definition: Sleeveless quilted insulated vest, down or synthetic filled.

name: Cut-off vest (battle vest)
definition: Sleeveless denim or leather vest with its sleeves cut off, worn as a base for patches.

name: Waistcoat
definition: Fitted sleeveless tailored garment worn under a jacket or alone.

name: Hi-vis vest
definition: Sleeveless fluorescent vest with reflective bands, worn for visibility.

name: Life jacket
definition: Buoyant vest or jacket worn to keep the wearer afloat.

name: Poncho
definition: Outer garment of a single piece of cloth with a head opening and no sleeves.

name: Cape (cloak)
definition: Sleeveless outer garment hanging from the shoulders, open at the front.

name: Underwear
definition: Garments worn next to the skin under other clothing, such as briefs, boxers, bras and vests.

name: Thermal base layer
definition: Close-fitting garment worn next to the skin for warmth.

name: Corset (foundation garment)
definition: Shaping garment worn under clothing to mould the figure.

name: Period underwear
definition: Underwear made with absorbent layers for use during menstruation.

name: Socks
definition: Knitted covering for the foot and ankle or lower leg.

name: Tights
definition: Close-fitting knitted covering for the feet, legs and hips in one piece.

name: Stockings
definition: Close-fitting knitted covering for the foot and leg, held up by a garter or a band.

name: Leg warmers
definition: Tubes of knitted fabric worn over the lower leg without a foot.

name: Gaiters
definition: Covering for the lower leg and ankle worn over trousers or boots.

name: Pyjamas
definition: Two-piece sleep garment of a top and trousers.

name: Nightdress
definition: One-piece loose sleep garment of dress form.

name: Bathrobe
definition: Absorbent or soft robe worn before or after bathing or at home.

name: Wearable baby sleeping bag
definition: Sleeveless or sleeved sleep sack worn by a baby in place of blankets.

name: Swimsuit
definition: One-piece garment for swimming and bathing.

name: Bikini
definition: Two-piece swimwear of a top and a brief.

name: Swim trunks
definition: Shorts or briefs for swimming, worn by men and boys.

name: Beach cover-up
definition: Loose garment worn over swimwear at the beach or pool.

name: Cap
definition: Brimmed or peaked head covering fitted to the head, without a full brim.

name: Beanie
definition: Close-fitting knitted head covering with no brim.

name: Hat
definition: Head covering with a crown and a brim, or a shaped crown.

name: Hard hat
definition: Rigid helmet made to protect the head at work from falling objects and impact.

name: Motorcycle helmet
definition: Helmet made for motorcycle riders.

name: Cycling helmet
definition: Helmet made for riders of bicycles.

name: Welding helmet
definition: Helmet with a darkening visor made to protect the face and eyes of a welder.

name: Bee veil
definition: Mesh veil worn over the head and face by beekeepers.

name: Safety glasses
definition: Eyewear made to protect the eyes from a hazard.

name: Ear defenders
definition: Ear muffs made to reduce noise reaching the ears.

name: Respirator
definition: Face-worn device made to filter or supply air against dust, fumes or gas.

name: Face mask (medical or surgical)
definition: Mask worn over the nose and mouth for medical or surgical protection.

name: Scarf
definition: Length of cloth or knitted fabric worn round the neck.

name: Necktie
definition: Strip of cloth worn round the collar and knotted at the front.

name: Arm sleeve
definition: Tube of fabric worn over the forearm or arm; one made for a sport is E2.

name: Arm warmer
definition: Tube of knitted fabric worn over the forearm for warmth.

name: Glove
definition: Covering for the hand with a separate sheath for each finger.

name: Mitten
definition: Covering for the hand with one sheath for the thumb and one for the fingers.

name: Belt
definition: Strip of leather, fabric or other material worn round the waist.

name: Sash
definition: Wide band of cloth worn round the waist or over a shoulder.

name: Belt buckle
definition: Buckle sold loose and made to be fitted to a belt.

name: Collar stay
definition: Stiffener slipped into the underside of a shirt collar.

name: Detachable lining or hood
definition: Lining or hood made to be fitted to and removed from one garment.
